title: Applying for a summer job
context_es: Has visto un anuncio de trabajo de verano en un campamento internacional de idiomas en Irlanda y escribes para solicitarlo.
prompt_en:
You have seen this advertisement on an English-language website:

Summer staff wanted
Greenhill International Camp (Ireland) is looking for friendly, responsible people to work with children aged 8 to 14 in July and August. You should speak good English and enjoy sports or creative activities.

Write to Ms Karen Doyle, the camp director, saying why you are suitable for the job and when you are available.

Write your email.
points: explain why you are suitable for the job
useful_language: I am writing to apply for the position of …
For the last two summers, I have worked as …
I believe I would be suitable for the job because …
I would be available from … until …
Thank you for considering my application.
I look forward to hearing from you.
tips_es: Es un correo formal: *Dear Ms Doyle,* … *Yours sincerely,* y ninguna contracción.
Di en la primera frase para qué escribes y dónde viste el anuncio.
No te limites a decir que eres responsable: da un ejemplo que lo demuestre.
model_answer:
Dear Ms Doyle,

I am writing to apply for the position of summer staff at Greenhill International Camp, which I saw advertised on your website.

I am a twenty-two-year-old student of primary education from Spain. For the last two summers, I have worked as an activity leader at a sports camp in my home town, where I was responsible for a group of fifteen children. In addition, I have been teaching swimming to young children at weekends since 2024.

I believe I would be suitable for the job for several reasons. Firstly, I am patient and reliable, and I genuinely enjoy working with children. Secondly, I have a B2 level of English, which I use every day at university. Finally, I can play the guitar, so I would be happy to organise music and drama activities as well as sports.

I would be available from 1 July until the end of August, and I could attend an interview online at any time.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Marina Soler
